title: 云南菌子季②松茸：一斤上千，为什么种不出来 | Yunnan Wild Mushrooms P2 · Matsutake 🍄
description:
松茸你会怎么吃？炭烤还是煲汤？评论区见。

【云南菌子季·第2集 松茸】一朵品相好的松茸，一斤能卖到1000到1500元。它金贵，是因为至今无法人工种植——松茸只跟松树、栎树的根共生，人一插手它就不长，只能等雨后进山去"捡"。采菌人天不亮就上山。香格里拉（迪庆）松茸是国家地理标志产品，可就算上了冷链，也只能保鲜五天左右。所以松茸的贵，是野生的贵。

Ep.2 Matsutake. A top-grade matsutake sells for ¥1000–1500 a pound. Why? It still cannot be cultivated — it lives only in symbiosis with pine and oak roots; meddle and it won't grow. You wait for rain and forage it, climbing before dawn. Shangri-La (Diqing) matsutake is a geographic-indication product, yet even cold-chain holds it barely five days. Its price is simply the price of wild.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture & safety note, not medical or dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
